title: Haus Of Tides | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Haus of Tides,' a cozy coastal retreat in the exclusive gated community of Sunset Beach, Seacrest. Steps from the Gulf, this home offers private deeded beach access and a stunning community pool with breathtaking ocean views. Explore the area with ease using the included four adult bikes, or stroll over to the Seacrest Village for dining, shopping, and entertainment. With its unbeatable location and upscale amenities, Haus of Tides is the perfect spot to unwind and make memories. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Private Deed Beach Access -Beautiful Community Pool -4 Adult Bikes -Outdoor Patio with Dining and Sitting Areas -Two Balconies -Smart TVs -Gas Grill -Beach Gear -2 Dedicated Parking Spots ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 8 2 Bedrooms / 3 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Queen Sleeper Sofa SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: Bunk Room, Full over Full with Private Bath -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two parking spaces available (2 driveway). Included are 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SUNSET BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Villas of Sunset Beach is a gated community, located beachside on Highway 30A in Seacrest Beach, Florida. Driving down the palm tree-lined boulevard is only the beginning of a totally luxurious experience. Located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches and within walking distance to casual or fine dining. No dragging your beach gear across the street because the beautiful emerald waters of the gulf and the beachfront community pool are only steps away. Spacious gulf-front condominiums and elegant gulf-side homes make this community perfect for everyone. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. BEACH ACCESS Enjoy private deeded beach access just past the community pool. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a selfie. Other things to note
